_doc: Physical layout of the ST185-harness drawing set (all 13 harnesses of the master in one drawing set) for build_drawings.py: the trunk and branches as a tree, top view (front of the car to the RIGHT, driver side UP; DECISIONS R140 / R153), with segment lengths in mm. Whole-car frame: x -20 (rear bumper) .. 90 (firewall) .. 140 (front bumper), y 0 passenger edge .. 100 driver edge. Lengths come from the approved routes (AB-cabin: Routes 5 and 6; AB-engine: built at run time from Route 16 by `route_trees`, DECISIONS B8: map length x 5.3 mm per EWD point + 300 mm drop for a low part; each bulkhead-to-device path = the master est_length_mm) and the old A-cabin / B-cabin bundle lengths (2026-10-19); the other harnesses from Routes 1, 2 and 7-15 (2026-10-20). Each harness is its own bundle and the layout must stay a tree, so a place reached two ways is drawn twice (the starter: S post on the engine tree, through bulkhead cavity 3, B+ stud on the heavy-cable tree); harness C joins the engine tree at the MR-S pump; they are estimates until measured at the car (OPEN-ITEMS row 143). Positions (`xy`, a 0-100 frame: x toward the front, y toward the driver side) are drawing positions only, not to scale; `short` is the name drawn on the sheet. Every wire end of the wire list is placed on a node by `place` (the master end ID) or `place_oem` (text in the factory end's name); build_drawings.py --check fails on an end it cannot place. `lab` (left / below / above) moves a node name off its segments.

ECU.label: ECU plugs A / B (centre dash, factory ECM spot)

SP.label: ECU splice point (bussed DT plugs + soldered splices)

GB.label: Glove box: POWER + LOGIC boxes (every cabin fuse and relay), NEG bar, SW12 bus, blower lead
GB.short: Glove box: POWER + LOGIC boxes, NEG bar

RHKICK.label: RH kick panel (old R/B No.4 spot): ST1 / heater taps, ground IG
RHKICK.short: RH kick panel (old R/B4, ground IG)

RHSILL.label: RH sill, rear end (the run turns across the trunk)

FUEL.label: Trunk LH: IX-FUEL inline to the fuel sender

DASH.label: Mid-dash above the ECU: front + rear WS inlines, A/C switch lead

JB1.label: J/B No.1 + cowl plug IE1, LH kick panel: IG2 / tail / turn taps, door switch lead, ground ID (Routes 2, 7, 15)

ALARM.label: Anti-theft unit (centre dash, left of the ECU)

CSB3.label: Centre console: CSB3 under the centre cluster, its switch inputs and opto board; alarm status LED (Routes 12, 14)

CANJ.label: CAN trunk at the ECU: CAN H / L joins, ECU 120 ohm end (Route 8)

BH_ENG.label: DRB102 bulkhead, engine half (RH firewall); the engine tree is built from Route 16 (route_trees)

FW_STR.label: RH firewall: RADLOK pair, cabin side - spot TBD (Route 1 point 1)

CLUSTER.label: Centre cluster (old meter spot): LED board on the meter plugs C11 / C12, cluster CAN board + buck, J/B No.3 behind it (Routes 8, 13)

PI.label: RealDash Pi + USB-CAN adapter, centre dash, and the dash 12 V split (Route 8)

COLUMN.label: Steering column: cruise stalk C14 flying leads (Route 12, spot approximate)

VALET.label: Valet / program switch lead, under the carpet to the driver-side carpet centre, service coil (Route 14)

RFG.label: Existing factory RH fender grommet, RH front inner fender corner: harness C, alarm siren + hood pin, alternator IG / L / S (Routes 1, 2, 14)

RFP.label: RH fender pass-through by the strut tower: FR wheel-speed plug (Route 9 rev 2)

LFP.label: LH fender pass-through by the strut tower, driver kick: FL wheel-speed plug; wiper feed out to the cowl (Routes 2, 9)

WIPER.label: Front wiper motor F9, under the cowl, driver side (Route 2 point 18)

LHSILL.label: LH sill, rear end: under the rear seat (rear wheel-speed legs meet; rear-light run turns to the quarter panel; Routes 10, 15)

RLJ.label: LH quarter panel centre (OEM joint BP1): rear-light splices (Route 15)

RPANEL.label: Rear panel centre: licence lamp L1, ground point BL, trunk pin switch (Routes 14, 15)
RPANEL.short: Rear panel centre: L1, ground BL

WSRL.label: RL ABS sensor plug (rear left; Route 10)

WSRR.label: RR ABS sensor plug (rear right; its cable crosses under the rear seat to the LH sill, Route 10)

TANK.label: Fuel tank: fuel pump and the level sender (DT 2-way), trunk LH ground stud (Route 11 rev 2)

BATT.label: Trunk RH rear corner: battery, kill switch, battery relay block (FP 40 A fuse + fuel pump relay K-FP) (Route 1 points 1, 4)
BATT.short: Trunk RH: battery, kill sw, relay block

C_FEND.label: Harness C: down the RH inner fender (A/C branch, EPS pump) (Route 2 rev 12)

ACC.label: A/C compressor A4 clutch lead + dual pressure switch A5 (Route 2 point 7)

C_RHC.label: RH front corner: headlamp H2, turn / clearance F8, retract motor R3, washer W1, hood pin, ground EA (Route 2 point 15)

FANC.label: Condenser fan (own connector; first stop on the fan branch, Route 2 point 9)

FANR.label: Radiator fan (own connector; end of the fan branch, Route 2 point 10)

C_FRONT.label: Core support, front centre: horn split, both horns (DT 2-way each), headlamp / retract / clearance return joins (Route 2 points 8, 17)

C_LHC.label: LH front corner: headlamp H1, turn / clearance F7, retract motor R2, ground EB (Route 2 point 16)

SIREN.label: Alarm siren: centre of the firewall behind the engine, leads through the RH fender grommet (Route 14)

ALT.label: Alternator G2 round 3-pin plug (IG / L / S, through the RH fender grommet) - rear RH of the engine under the bulkhead (Route 1 point 3)

RL_ENG.label: RADLOK + / - pair, engine side (RH firewall) (Route 1 point 1)

ALT_B.label: Alternator B+ stud, rear RH of the engine (Route 1 point 3)

STARTER_B.label: Starter B+ stud (H4, H5, H8 lugs) (Route 1 point 2)

JUMP.label: Engine-bay jump post (Route 1 point 6, proposed spot)
